evidence.summary: CUMT’s Science and Technology Research Institute sets out how the university recognises and manages defence science and technology projects, including contracts from military-industry or defence departments and classified military research it carries out for other units.
Since 2022 CUMT has been co-built by the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Emergency Management and the Jiangsu government.
